También soporta la creación automática de nombres de atributos. • Experimental:Math Mix POP: Permite mezclar datos de múltiples entradas. useCases: Multi-step attribute math pipelines in a single node
Combining attributes from multiple inputs with auto-naming (in1_, in2_)
Creating complex derived attributes (dot product, cross product, smoothstep)
Debugging GLSL shaders via generated code inspection (Info DAT)

examples.name: State Blend
examples.description: Two Attribute POPs → Math Mix POP (mix operation) for smooth blending

examples.name: Color Transform
examples.description: Math Mix POP (RGBtoHSV → modify V → HSVtoRGB) for color manipulation

examples.name: Force Accumulation
examples.description: Math Mix POP (A+B*C for force = mass × acceleration)

commonCombinations: Two Attribute POPs → Math Mix POP (combine states)
CHOP to POP → Math Mix POP (process channel data)
Math Mix POP → GLSL POP (pre-process attributes)
Math Mix POP → Render TOP (output visualization)

troubleshooting.solution: Check Scope A/B/C match incoming attribute names. Use menu > to browse attributes.
Check Angle Units — degrees vs radians vs cycles.
Use Delete Input Attributes toggle carefully — it strips everything not kept.
Middle-click node for pseudocode, or attach Info DAT for generated GLSL.

description: Multi-step attribute math operator with sequential blocks. Each block operates on 1-3 attributes using 70+ operations (A+B, sin(A), mix(A,B,C), etc.). Supports multiple inputs with auto-naming (in1_, in2_ prefixes), built-in attributes (_ prefixed), and generates GLSL code viewable via Info DAT.
